name: IntegrateIT ESI R2D7 Shades
notes: Drives ESI / Draper R2D7 shade and screen systems over the published R2D7 V4.1 serial protocol: open/close/stop per system address and channel, configurable travel duration, a paced transmit queue that honors the unit's XON/XOFF flow control, and honest assumed-state tracking - the R2D7 acknowledges commands but never reports position.
